scenes.title: Customer churn by quarter
label: What it is
What it says
scenes.say: [casual] Your title names the chart. Customer churn by quarter. [beat] [emphatic] So what? Tell me what it says. [confident] Churn more than doubled this year.
[conversational] Then ask again. Topic... so what? Churn doubled. So what? [pointed] Fix onboarding before we raise prices.
[upbeat] Not what it is. What it says. Then ask again. [playful] Now ask your last title... so what?
